cause_quote: The diff added `legacyCredentials: [String: String]? = nil` to the Equatable `.nativeDevice` case and cleared that field on socket retirement with `self.auth = .nativeDevice(gatewayUrl: gatewayUrl, token: token, password: password)`.
user_saw: A message queued offline in the macOS dashboard could disappear when the app reconnected to the same Gateway.
summary: The fix preserves the dashboard WebView across same-Gateway reconnects and refreshes the startup credentials used on future loads.
reasoning: Before #159860, the shared-credential auth value compared during reconnect contained only the Gateway URL, token, and password, so unchanged settings kept the existing WebView and its offline queue. The introducing diff made that same comparison sensitive to socket-owned credentials, so retirement before reconnect made otherwise identical configurations compare unequal and caused the dashboard to replace the WebView.
